stem: A contractor brings a personal tool bag into a controlled cultivation area. What should happen before the tools are used?
choices: Use them immediately if the contractor says they are clean
Apply the facility's entry and tool-control procedure, including cleaning/disinfection or restriction as required
Place the bag under a bench so it is out of sight
Use the tools only on healthy plants
rationale: External tools can introduce contaminants. Facility intake and tool-control procedures should govern whether and how they enter production areas.
